Definition: from a compound of G4012 and G2508; something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively):--filth.
BiblicalUsage: Perikatharma is the filth cleaned off, the offscouring. Paul says the apostles are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all things unto this day.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that the apostles wore the world's contempt as their uniform: filth to men, and precious to God.
